description: A slender, long-tailed, two-legged dinosaur with a toothy open jaw and spiky crest-like scales runs at speed across a dry, rocky riverbank in a dim, painterly landscape of ferns, a cliff face and dead branches. A small lizard-like reptile scurries in the lower left, away from its path. Dust and pebbles fly from its feet. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
